primaryChecks.text: Then Asa the king took all Judah, and they carried away the stones and timber of Ramah, with which Baasha had built; and he built Geba and Mizpah with them.
primaryChecks.previousContext: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease.
primaryChecks.nextContext: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said to him, “Because you have relied on the king of Syria, and have not relied on the LORD your God, therefore the army of the king of Syria has escaped out of your hand.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文に町名が明記される。ゲバと並べてアサが資材を使って築いた町として記すが、書内本文だけではベニヤミンのどのミツパかを確定できない。
